metadata.title: GXGeneratedPage.addUserExits() Clears All Global Security Lifecycle Hooks

transformations: clearEventListeners() removes ALL listeners from root-singleton UserExitsEventThrowerService
sinks: firePostConnect() — delivers CreateSessionResponse (token) to replaced listener
firePreConnect() — delivers authHeader credential to replaced listener
firePreSendKey() / firePostSendKey() — delivers all keystrokes and screen data

privilege_boundary.start_privilege: Authenticated developer with privileged GXGeneratedPage subclass creation rights
privilege_boundary.achieved_privilege: Replacement of all global security lifecycle hooks — credential capture capability for all users

impact.description: Insider threat: addUserExits() calls clearEventListeners() which removes ALL registered listeners before adding attacker's listener. Requires privileged developer access. CVSS downgraded from 8.2 to 3.8 LOW as exploitation requires developer-level code deployment privilege.

remediation.fix_approach: FIXED: clearEventListeners() removed from addUserExits() — append-only registration.

history.note: clearEventListeners() in addUserExits() replaces ALL global security hooks — any GXGeneratedPage subclass can install a data-exfiltrating listener
CONFIRMED LOW: Insider threat. Requires developer-level code deployment privilege. CVSS downgraded 8.2 → 3.8 LOW. Attack chain: VULN-004 + VULN-005 for credential capture.
FIXED: clearEventListeners() removed from addUserExits() — append-only registration.
